data.name: Demolition Expert 拆迁专家
data.detailed_description:
The game is currently in an early stage of development, and anyone can join the playtest for free. What are you waiting for? Come and experience it for yourself!
Demolition Expert

Demolition Expert is a simulation game dedicated to the art of building destruction. We have constructed a dual-layer physics engine that allows you to do everything from punching a small hole in a wall to bringing an entire structure crashing down with a thunderous roar, delivering a hyper-realistic destruction experience.

Game Features

Granular Destruction System： Every brick in a wall and every chunk of concrete in a load-bearing pillar can be destroyed independently. Whether it's an office building or a bridge, and no matter how massive the structure is, you can dismantle it down to the smallest unit—a single brick or a piece of concrete.

Building Mechanics Simulation： In Demolition Expert, you don't need to slice a building completely in half to make it fall. Every building is constrained by realistic mechanics. We have built a dedicated physics system to handle gravity and structural load. You can chip away at the structure indiscriminately until the moment the remaining supports can no longer bear the weight, causing the whole thing to collapse instantly.

Real-Time Simulation & Persistent Dust Fields： There are no pre-baked animations for collapsing buildings or smoke effects. Every collapse and smoke plume is calculated in real-time—you will never see a building fall the exact same way twice. When a large section of a building is destroyed, it kicks up a massive dust field spanning thousands of cubic meters that lingers for tens of seconds. Crucially, this dust field respects physics: it will not clip or bleed through the building to the other side.

Gameplay

Challenge Levels： The game offers over a dozen maps and dozens of imaginative, mind-bending levels for players to challenge. From destroying a building within a time limit to breaking through obstacles to reach a specific point, you can utilize a vast array of weapons, sci-fi props, and even magic to achieve your goals.

Balanced Difficulty & Sandbox Destruction： Is a level too hard, or is the massive scale of destruction causing you computer to get stuck? Don't worry—the game features a fail-safe mechanism to ensure you can always clear the stage. Furthermore, Free Mode for each map unlocks simultaneously with its Challenge Mode. This means you have ample time to enjoy stress-relieving destruction—for example, sticking dozens of sticky bombs to a building and detonating them all at once for a spectacular "fireworks" display. This also gives you plenty of time to study the structural attributes of every building.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows10/windows11
  • Processor: Intel i5 9600k/Ryzen R5 3600X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX3050
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: windows10/windows11
  • Processor: Intel i5 12600k/Ryzen R5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX4060
